WITH award_throws AS (
  SELECT p.throws
  FROM player_award pa
  JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
),
throws_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM award_throws
  GROUP BY throws
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    count,
    SUM(count) OVER () as total_count,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as num_hands
  FROM throws_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    count,
    total_count,
    num_hands,
    count * 1.0 / total_count as share,
    1.0 / num_hands as global_avg_share
  FROM with_stats
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > global_avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - global_avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
